faqPairs.question: Is the Digital Product Passport ESPR-compliant?

faqPairs.question: How does AI data extraction work?
faqPairs.answer: Upload PDFs and delivery notes; our AI extracts relevant product data. You confirm results in review — usually done in 5 minutes.

faqPairs.question: Do I need my own IT department?
faqPairs.answer: No. DPP-Flash is easy-to-use Digital Product Passport software and requires no IT expertise.

faqPairs.question: How does DPP-Flash compare to other platforms?
faqPairs.answer: We benchmark published competitor tiers and price each plan roughly 20% below the closest equivalent, with more included — supplier portal on every plan and AI extraction from Starter.

faqPairs.question: Are there per-passport or setup fees?
